origin.description: Convert an object to a raw vector. Used by hmac.

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: The object to convert. Dispatches on raw, character, digest, and the default method.

origin.details: A raw vector is returned unchanged. A character string uses charToRaw. A longer character vector warns and keeps the first string. A hex digest is split into pairs and converted with as.hexmode. The default method is as.raw: truncate toward zero, and values outside [-1, 256) become 0 with one warning.

translation.description: Convert an object to bytes. hmac calls make_raw_digest on a hex hash.

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: bytes are returned as bytes. A str is charToRaw. DigestHex is parsed as hex. A list of numbers is as.raw. None is empty.

translation.details: A plain str is not parsed as hex. make_raw_digest splits hex pairs, including a final one-character pair. An empty hex string is the seq(1, 0, 2) error. as.raw truncates toward zero. Only non-finite values and numbers outside [-1, 256) become 0, with one warning.
